author: Fouled
body:
This subforum is very similar to the Map Releases subforum that is listed under Map Development. Tournament map submissions are to be posted here, this is so that it will not get mixed in with public map submissions and it will be noticed more by the officials.

Formatting
When making a map thread, we'd like the following information to be present,
- Map name
- Authors
- Contributors (optional)
- Map Pictures

Do not post the download, if we decide to further evaluate your map or accept it for testing, then we will contact you.
XML is optional to have, most cases the map development or official team will make it.

Officials are allowed to make map adjustments if something is needed to be fixed/edited as a beneficial cause. We will contact you if something major is changed.

Thanks,
The Officials
